resources.string: Connect your phone to your Bridget federation. Choose a machine, find an agent and send an instruction.
Scan a QR from your trusted Bridget installation
An association is awaiting confirmation. Reconcile this attempt before scanning another QR.
Refresh to list available agents. Only authorized projects appear.
This instruction is sent only to the selected agent.
Commands are saved before sending. If a response is lost, check its receipt. Never create a new command to retry.
New work is sent to registered agents. Direct agent creation is not enabled.
This phone will lose access. Drafts and command receipts will remain stored locally.
Keep the saved command. Check the receipt before another send.
This action is outside your authorized scope
Bridget is busy. Try reading again later.
This QR is not a valid Bridget association
Some events are missing. This view is not a complete history.
This command belongs to another association
Keep this saved command. Consult its original Bridget installation before any new send.
This renewal belongs to another association
Keep the pending authorization. Consult the original installation before replacing it.
Saved observation. Current availability is not confirmed.
Live follow paused. Read the conversation or reconnect.
PDF, UTF-8 text, HTML, Markdown, PNG or JPEG. Maximum 8 MiB per file. Local encrypted staging: 32 MiB.
This records a native cancellation request. Read the task again to confirm its state. A result that already arrived is preserved.
Pause and continuation buttons prepare an instruction for the parent. They do not confirm a provider action.
Only offered choices can be sent. A saved choice, producer acknowledgement and confirmed application are separate states.
Facts supplied by the native request
Quoted model text — verify before deciding
The native request was not applied
Processed by the producer. Provider application is not confirmed.
Check its receipt first. This resends the same key and the same envelope. It never creates a replacement command.
Insert the reference into the draft
This removes this phone’s record and its staged file. It does not cancel work or delete the server’s canonical file. Unknown outcomes are protected.
Received by Bridget. Delivery is not yet observed.
This key refers to a different envelope
Use an authorized scope. Historical reads require an explicit whole-federation authorization; no rights were expanded.
The output copy may be incomplete. Keep the native reference and save a verified copy again.
Read again from a valid history position. Saved commands are preserved.
Instruction prepared. Review it before sending.
Please pause task %1$s if your native capabilities allow it. Report the actual state. Do not create a replacement task.
Please continue task %1$s through its authorized native path. Check its receipt and actual state first. Do not create a replacement task.
This choice is not offered. Read the current question.
This question already has a decision. Read its receipt.
The published-file quota is reached. No existing file was removed.
The request does not match this protocol version.
This view’s resource limit has been reached.
The Bridget master is temporarily unreachable.
Response not confirmed. Check the saved receipt.

This forgets only this phone’s current access. It does not revoke that access on the server. Revoke it from a trusted installation if necessary. Saved commands, drafts and files remain tied to their original association and are not resent.
Bridget has an update. Open the app to read it.
Optional alerts use Google FCM. No conversation text, agent name or project is sent. Delivery depends on Android and the network.
Notifications are not configured on this installation yet.
Android notification permission was denied. You can enable it in Android app settings.
Notification registration is not confirmed. Your local preference is preserved.
Preference saved. Registration with Bridget is not confirmed yet.
Open the official GitHub download. Android asks you to confirm installation and verifies the package signature. Keep the existing app installed to preserve its data.
The release check is unavailable. No update was downloaded. Try again later.
The latest release has no Android package yet. No update was downloaded.
Local phone time. Messages remain available during quiet hours.
Enter two different times, for example 22:00 and 08:00.
This QR can no longer pair your phone. It expired, was already used, or no longer matches this attempt.
A QR lasts five minutes and pairs one device. Tap “Associate again”, then scan a new QR from your trusted installation. Your saved messages and files will not be erased.
This reading window has reached its limit. Return to the latest messages to resume the recent feed.
The message is still saved on this phone. Once connected again, open Outbox and send the saved message.
Deliver now may interrupt a running tool so the agent can take your message into account. It does not request an agent restart.
Long output: the displayed excerpt is limited.
Some details were not provided by the source.
Local preview · scripts and external resources disabled
Preview unavailable. You can save the file.
